spec: §15 suite E; §6.4: the target capability mbu is reserved and MUST be false (measurement-based cleanup is not admitted in sched/cert 0.8)
derivation: A target document with capabilities.mbu true is invalid at load: measurement-based cleanup has no certificate kind in cert 0.8 and the capability must read false (the valid target.json in E-target-staged-probe has it false).
